segments.text: Good morning, please sit. How are you today?
Good morning doctor. I am fine, just this back problem. It is a lovely day, no?
Yes. What work do you do?
I drive a delivery van. I fell from my scooter about three weeks ago and since then I have lower back pain.
Does the pain go down to your leg?
Yes, down my left leg to the foot, and my foot feels numb. It is worse when I sit for long. I have no fever and no problem passing urine.
I take amlodipine 5 mg once daily for blood pressure for five years. I am allergic to penicillin, I got a rash as a child.
My father also had a slipped disc, that is why I ask. On examination there is reduced power in the left ankle and straight leg raising is positive on the left.
We will get an MRI of the lumbar spine. Take tablet paracetamol 650 mg twice daily for five days and avoid lifting.
Come back after 5 days with the MRI report. Come sooner if the leg weakness increases.
Thank you doctor, see you soon.
